name: FARDAGARI
author: fardagar

sections.description:
An AI assisted chatbot trained on your own data , Answering Customers 24/7.

Fardagari lets you add a custom AI assistant to your WordPress website and train it on your own website pages content, documents, and business content.

The chatbot answers visitors’ questions, around the clock, using information from your own knowledge base.

It supports 100+ languages and is designed with source transparency, accuracy, and European data residency in mind.

All your documents are on secure servers all residing in Europe.

Train It on Your Business Content

Build your chatbot’s knowledge base using your website and documents.

  • Upload Documents — Add PDF, DOCX, and TXT files.
  • Scan Your Website — Automatically discover pages from your website and choose which ones to add.
  • Add Individual URLs — Add Add individual webpage URLs from any website, manually to your knowledge base when required.

Powerful Features for Your Business

Key Features

  • Privacy-First: Total privacy. Your documents are residing on secure servers all in Europe. Your data is never sold, never shared with third parties, and never used to train AI models. Each company’s data is isolated and cannot be accessed by others.
  • Multilingual: Excels in 100+ languages including English, Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Arabic, Persian, Turkish, Urdu, Hindi, and more.
  • Accurate & Verifiable Answers — Combines fast hybrid search with direct source citations, enabling users to trace and verify every response.
  • full-duplex conversational AI You ask question by speaking and the chatbot also answers by voice in multiple languages. (new in 1.1.0)
  • Chatbot Customization — Adjust the widget’s appearance by choosing from a variety of icons. (new in 1.1.0)

Start Free

Start with our Free Plan which includes:

  • 2,000 messages per month
  • 50 MB knowledge-base storage
  • No credit card required

Coming Soon

We’re actively building these features:

  • Analytics — See exactly what your customers are asking, and where your knowledge base needs more content, so you can improve it based on real interactions.

visitor chat messages to that service to generate answers.

sections.installation:
Setting up your Fardagari chatbot is simple and requires no technical expertise.

  1. In your WordPress admin area, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Fardagari.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. In your WordPress admin sidebar, go to Fardagari to open the plugin settings.
  5. Click Connect to Fardagar. You will be taken to SignIn page .
  6. If you have not registered yet then click signUp, to create a free account.(Public email services are not supported.). A verification email will be sent to you. Check your email and click the verification link to activate your account.
  7. Once logged in, go to the Dashboard in the website. You will be in management page. Here you can scan your website and upload documents to build your knowledge base.
  8. When setup is complete, click button “Back to WordPress” , you will be taken back to your wordpress website. The chatbot will be enabled on your website automatically when setup is finished.

Account Requirements

  • An account to website Fardagar AI is required to use this chatbot.
  • A company email address is mandatory for sign-up (public email services such as Gmail,Yahoo mail etc. are not supported).
  • Your Fardagar.ai sign-in/sign-up email must use the same domain as your WordPress admin email. For example, if your WordPress admin email is me@mycompany.com, then your Fardagar.ai email must also end with @mycompany.com. The part before the @ can be different.
  • Your WordPress site must use HTTPS.

Building Your Knowledge Base

You can add information to your chatbot in several ways:

  1. Website Scanning — Enter or select your website and scan it to discover available pages. Select the pages you want to add to your chatbot by checking checkboxes. If your website has sitemap.xml, then click button “Scan Now” in front of discovered sitemap URL to list the pages. Once selected, click button “Ingest Selected”. The information in selected pages will become part of your knowledge base. It may take several seconds to complete. Processing time depends on the amount of content being added.
  2. Document Upload — Upload PDF, DOCX, or TXT files.
  3. Manual URL Entry — Add specific web pages manually.
  4. Managing Your Knowledge Base — At later stage, when your documents are revised or updated, you can delete the old version and add new ones.
sections.faq:
Why choose Fardagari Chatbot?

There are many AI chatbot plugins available for WordPress, so why choose Fardagari?

Our focus is simple: A chatbot that provides accurate, grounded answers, and Strong data privacy, rather than adding dozens of features you may never use.

1. Answers with source references

Answers include links to the source pages used to generate them, allowing you and your visitors to verify the original information.

Behind the scenes, Fardagari uses comprehensive retrieval techniques including hybrid search, dense and sparse embeddings, ColBERT reranking, and query rewriting. These techniques help retrieve the most relevant information from your knowledge base before an answer is generated.

2. Your business data stays in Europe

Your business content is stored and processed in European cloud regions.

Fardagari’s main application and knowledge-base infrastructure operates in Frankfurt, Germany. AI inference operates in Stockholm, Sweden, and our embedding infrastructure is restricted to European data centers.

We use established cloud infrastructure providers including Oracle Cloud, AWS, and RunPod while configuring customer workloads to remain within European regions.

Your data is never used to train any AI model.

Is the chatbot really free? What is the catch?

Yes. Fardagari is currently in its early growth stage, and we participate in startup support programs from companies such as NVIDIA and AWS.

These programs help reduce some of our infrastructure and technology costs, and we are passing part of that benefit on to our early users.

The current free-plan limits (2000 messages per month, 50MB data storage) gives early users the opportunity to use Fardagari for free while helping us improve the service through real-world use and feedback.

What happens if the chatbot doesn’t know an answer?

The chatbot will respond that it doesn’t have the answer in its knowledge base, rather than making something up. This ensures your customers always receive accurate information. You can always add more content to improve the chatbot’s responses.

Is my data secure?

Yes, we take data security seriously. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Your documents are processed and stored securely. Each company’s data is isolated and cannot be accessed by others. We comply with data protection standard practices.

What is your pricing?

Fardagar currently offers a free plan that includes:

  • 2,000 messages per month
  • 50 MB knowledge-base storage
  • No credit card required

Paid plans for businesses requiring higher usage will be introduced in the future.

Our first 100 customers will retain the current free-plan usage limits for one year after paid plans are introduced and the standard free-plan limits are reduced.
